method.method_draft: Read the t-test table in the image: the test reports t Stat = -0.72914, P(T≤t) one-tail = 0.246692, P(T≤t) two-tail = 0.493384, with critical values 1.94318 one-tail and 2.446912 two-tail. Apply the standard significance-test rule, typically using alpha = 0.05 unless otherwise stated: because the p-value is much larger than 0.05, and equivalently because the absolute t statistic is smaller than the critical t value, the result is not statistically significant. Therefore, conclude that the null hypothesis cannot be rejected.
